correctness.rationale: Independently expanded the per-step oscillator update R_q(z)=1+z+qz²/2+qz³/6+q²z⁴/24 and real planar norm multiplier a_q²+b_q². Shared q per step and independence between steps imply E||u_n||²=m_ε(θ)^n||u_0||² exactly. Symbolic expansion confirmed m−1=x²[(1+6s+s²)x²−(8+56s)x+192s]/576 for x=θ²,s=ε²; discriminant is 64(1+2s−23s²−12s³). Positive-root sign analysis gives the open stability band for 0<ε<ε_c, noise-free θ<2√2, neutral coalescence at ε_c and strict growth beyond. Noise law, positive θ and deterministic initial vector quantifiers are explicit.
residual_risks: Strict convergence requires m<1; at ε=ε_c neutral step does not decay.
